Oricorio

Fire Flying

Alola · Generation 7

Oricorio is a Fire/Flying-type Dancing Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 3.4 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (98), with a base stat total of 476.
